title: Federal
features:
-----------------------------------------
1ST TAB:

R15 Reanimation
R6  Reanimation
*needed for custom animations*

Copy player - copies everything they do, for example their walk, emotes etc.

Grab head - Grabs the players head

Stretch - you can change your body width & height by turning this option on

Map shitter

Freeze
Invisible

2ND TAB:

Helicopter
Creeper
Star glitcher
Xester
Creature 

these are all creatures you can turn into, R6 Reanimation is needed for this to work.

Christmas Countdown - sends how many days there is until christmas in chat

Swastika - sends a swastika in chat

Modify User - lets you char into a person without VIP

Orbit Player - makes you orbit around a person

Walk speed
Jump power

TP Walk
TP Walk speed

Fly
Fly speed

Noclip

Flashback - makes your character rewind

Face Fuck - makes you character start fucking somone in the face

Trip
Spaz trip

CCTV:
Camera lounge
Camera private rooms
Camera bathrooms
Camera donut shop

6TH TAB:

Front flip
Back flip
Left flip
WHAT THE FUCK FLIP FUCK AHHHHHH

Unclaim all stalls
*Makes you unclaim everyones stall*

8TH TAB:

Sync tool

9TH TAB:

Force Join Voice
Force Leave Voice

If your voice chat gets banned, you can use this to bypass it.

Become priority speaker - prioritizes your microphone input over other players.

10TH TAB:

R15 Animations - Opens a menu where you can use custom animations.
All emotes - Automatically gives you all the custom emotes.
Flash step - Opens a small gui where you can turn on/off flash step

Infinite yield
